newsitem.title: USA: Merrill Lynch files $3 bln shelf debt offer.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch files $3 bln shelf debt offer.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co Inc on Wednesday filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration of up to $3 billion in debt securities and warrants.
The offering totals $4.5 billion, when added to previously registered debt, the company said.

Proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes. No underwriters were named in the shelf offering, but the New York-based company said the securities may be offered through its unit Merrill Lynch Pierce Fenner & Smith.
